svg.title: HE-07.1 animated: plant run F-04b
svg.desc: Synthetic (DSR-12), no evidence credit. Looping animation of plant run F-04b for HE-07.1: the Corolla's lateral offset on a straightened road from 1 s before the fault to 4.7 s after it, the offset plot with a moving cursor and the 0.5 s FTTI band, and the events: fault: SoC stall: heartbeat and commands stop at 0.00 s; panda revokes steering authority at 0.05 s; driver cue: 0.2 m drift at 1.18 s; body on the 3.7 m lane line at 1.97 s; driver starts to correct at 2.68 s.
svg.text: The driver believes the system steers; departure in the curve
Plant run F-04b: left curve at R_ODD, fault at curve entry
road straightened; the car keeps its place, the road moves
body on the 3.7 m lane line (0.96 m)

g.text: fault: SoC stall: heartbeat and commands stop
body on the 3.7 m lane line
